- An existing docker-compose.yml with intentional bugs:

      myjavasvc:
        image: myregistry.local/myjavasvc:latest
        environment:
          - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
          - APP_TOKEN=${CUSTOM_APP_TOKEN}

The user pre-supplied these answers (don't call AskUserQuestion):

Batch 1:
- 项目结构: 单服务
- SERVICE_NAME: myjavasvc
- 部署环境: UAT only
- 禁用 ArgoCD: 是

Batch 2:
- 语言: Java + Maven
- 构建产物位置: A (在 CI 里独立 build-app)
- Dockerfile 模式: 参数化
- 编译环境镜像: jdk11.0.16_mvn3.0.5 (tag: cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/jdk11.0.16_mvn3.0.5:v1.0.0)

Batch 3:
- 运行时基础镜像: jre11.0.16 (tag: cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/jre11.0.16:v1.0.0)

Follow SKILL.md. The Dockerfile doesn't exist → generate it (parameterized Java + Tsinghua). docker-compose.yml exists → audit, fix the two violations (hardcoded image, non-CUSTOM_ DB_PASSWORD), via Edit (not rewrite). Output GitLab Variables checklist at end.
evals.expected_output: 1) .gitlab-ci.yml generated with: team-cicd include, variables.BUILD_TOOL=mvn, build-app re-enabled (rules + image override), build-container.variables.DOCKER_BUILD_ARGS with BASE_IMAGE + BUILD_FOLDER + PACKAGE_NAME + SERVICE_PORT, deploy-uat/deploy-prod (ArgoCD) disabled with when:never. 2) Dockerfile created (java-parameterized template, ARG BASE_IMAGE, ARG APT_MIRROR=tsinghua, COPY target/*.jar). 3) docker-compose.yml fixed via Edit: image line corrected to ${IMAGE_REGISTRY}/${SERVICE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG}, DB_PASSWORD placeholder renamed to ${CUSTOM_DB_PASSWORD}. 4) Variables checklist includes Docker Registry 4 + UAT SSH 7 + CUSTOM_DB_PASSWORD (Masked) + CUSTOM_APP_TOKEN (Masked).

services:
  myjavasvc:
    image: myregistry.local/myjavasvc:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:

      - APP_TOKEN=${CUSTOM_APP_TOKEN}

    restart: unless-stopped

evals.prompt:
Setup CICD for a multi-service mono-repo. Project directory has two service subdirs (svc-a/ and svc-b/, each with pom.xml or package.json).

The user pre-supplied these answers for Batch 1 (don't call AskUserQuestion):
- 项目结构: 多服务 mono-repo
- 项目前缀: demo
- 部署环境: UAT only
- 禁用 ArgoCD: 是

For Step 2.B (multi-service path), the user has ALREADY filled in cicd-services.yml at the project root (do NOT overwrite or ask). Read it and use the values directly. Content of cicd-services.yml:

  prefix: demo
  build_images:
    mvn: "cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/jdk11.0.16_mvn3.0.5:v1.0.0"

For Dockerfile_backend and Dockerfile_frontend (both don't exist), generate them (parameterized templates). evals.name: https-python-uvicorn
evals.prompt:
Setup CICD for an empty new Python project that serves HTTPS in container. The user pre-supplied these answers (don't call AskUserQuestion):

Batch 1:
- 项目结构: 单服务
- SERVICE_NAME: pyhttps
- 部署环境: UAT only
- 禁用 ArgoCD: 是

Batch 2:
- 语言: Python
- 构建产物位置: Dockerfile 多阶段构建
- Dockerfile 模式: 参数化
- 编译环境镜像: 不需要 (Python 跳过)

Batch 3:
- 运行时基础镜像: python:3.12-slim
- Q10 应用容器是否监听 HTTPS: B (是，容器自己 terminate SSL)
- Q11 CUSTOM_HOST_PORT: 443
- Q12 CUSTOM_APP_PORT: 8000

Follow SKILL.md. Q10=B 触发 Step 3.2 的 entrypoint 自动逻辑：生成的 Dockerfile 必须含 gosu install + COPY entrypoint-ssl.sh + ENTRYPOINT 行（不写 USER appuser，由 entrypoint 切换）；项目根要拷一份 entrypoint-ssl.sh 文件。docker-compose.yml 的 ports 行必须是 "443:${CUSTOM_APP_PORT:-8000}"。最终变量清单含 CUSTOM_HOST_PORT/CUSTOM_APP_PORT/UAT_SSL_CERT/UAT_SSL_KEY。Step 5 输出必含 HTTPS deployment gotchas 段。
evals.expected_output: Generated: .gitlab-ci.yml (team-cicd include, ArgoCD disabled, no BUILD_TOOL), Dockerfile (Python with ENTRYPOINT entrypoint-ssl.sh, no USER appuser at end, gosu installed), entrypoint-ssl.sh (chmod + gosu pattern), docker-compose.yml (ports: 443:8000), variables-checklist.md (含 CUSTOM_HOST_PORT=443, CUSTOM_APP_PORT=8000, UAT_SSL_CERT, UAT_SSL_KEY 都标必填). Final report has 'HTTPS deployment gotchas' section warning about cert permission + privileged ports.

evals.name: multi-node-lb-deploy
evals.prompt:
Setup CICD for a multi-service mono-repo that deploys PROD across TWO load-balanced VMs (master + slave), like PMS. Project has two service subdirs (svc-a/ Java, web/ Vue SPA).

The user pre-supplied Batch 1 (don't call AskUserQuestion):
- 项目结构: 多服务 mono-repo
- 项目前缀: demo
- 部署环境: UAT + PROD
- 禁用 ArgoCD: 是

cicd-services.yml is ALREADY filled at project root (do NOT overwrite or ask). Read and use it:

project:
  prefix: demo
  build_images:
    mvn: "cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/jdk11.0.16_mvn3.0.5:v1.0.0"
    npm: "cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/node18_npm9.8.1:v1.0.0"
services:
  - name: svc-a
    language: java-mvn
    build_folder: ./svc-a
    artifact_folder: target
    dockerfile: Dockerfile_backend
    base_image: "cld93-ld-tcr-premium-sh-001.tencentcloudcr.com/devops/jre11.0.16:v1.0.0"
    service_port: 8080
  - name: web
    language: node-npm
    build_folder: ./web
    artifact_folder: dist
    dockerfile: Dockerfile_frontend
    base_image: "nginx:1.29.4-alpine"
    service_port: 443
    serves_https: true
deploy:
  uat:
    nodes:
      - name: single
        target_var: UAT_TARGET
        compose_file: docker-compose-uat.yml
        nginx_conf: config/nginx/nginx-uat.conf
  prod:
    nodes:
      - name: master
        target_var: PROD_MASTER_TARGET
        compose_file: docker-compose-master.yml
        nginx_conf: config/nginx/nginx-prod-master.conf
      - name: slave
        target_var: PROD_SLAVE_TARGET
        compose_file: docker-compose-slave.yml
        nginx_conf: config/nginx/nginx-prod-slave.conf

Follow SKILL.md multi-service path. Skip the 'wait for user done' step (file is valid). Generate root .gitlab-ci.yml, ci/svc-a.yml, ci/web.yml, AND ci/deploy-nodes.yml (because deploy: is filled). Generate Dockerfile_backend + Dockerfile_frontend. Output the Variables checklist. Single docker-compose audit out of scope (the user maintains the per-node compose files themselves).
evals.expected_output: 1) Root .gitlab-ci.yml includes team-cicd sdlcapi workflow, includes local ci/deploy-nodes.yml, and disables the SINGLE-NODE deploy layer: deploy-container-uat when:never AND deploy-container-prod when:never. 2) COMPLIANCE (critical): NOWHERE in any generated file are DockerScan / SCA / GenSecurityReport / approval / appsec_approval / set-release-manager set to when:never. 3) ci/deploy-nodes.yml defines base jobs .deploy-node-pre and .deploy-node, and uses the GENERIC custom injection loop (contains "grep '^CUSTOM_'" and base64), NOT a long list of hardcoded `export FOO=` lines. 4) ci/deploy-nodes.yml has per-node job pairs: uat-single-pre/uat-single, prod-master-pre/prod-master, prod-slave-pre/prod-slave. Each carries its own DOCKER_COMPOSE_FILE (docker-compose-uat.yml / -master.yml / -slave.yml), its own NGINX_CONF (nginx-uat/-prod-master/-prod-slave.conf), and DEPLOY_TARGET pointing at the right var (UAT_TARGET / PROD_MASTER_TARGET / PROD_SLAVE_TARGET). 5) prod-master and prod-slave deploy jobs are when: manual (per-node manual gate); uat-single is on_success. 6) Variables checklist lists per-node target vars PROD_MASTER_TARGET / PROD_SLAVE_TARGET / UAT_TARGET (encoding user@host:/path) and notes CUSTOM_* are auto-injected to every node.
